spec.claim_summary: Buy when the daily close crosses above the 200-day moving average and sell when it falls back below it.

claimed.other: most recent trade that started after the crash of March 2020 returned 388%

assumptions: Asset is BTC from page context; mapped to BTCUSDT.
Timeframe is daily close from claim and 1d chart.
200 DMA interpreted as 200-period simple moving average (SMA).
Entry 'crossing above' encoded as crosses_above, not just close above.
Exit 'falls back down below' encoded as crosses_below to hold position between crosses.
No stop, target, or time exit stated so position held until opposite cross; no max_hold_bars.
388% refers to single most recent trade since March 2020 crash, not whole-period backtest; period dates not precisely stated so no claimed period set.

evidence.quote: Buy when the daily close is crossing above the 200 days moving average.
